  \node[qbox,right=0.22cm of enc]  (ans)  {Variational\\ansatz\\[1pt]\scriptsize SE\,/\,BE,\\depth $L$};
  \node[qbox,right=0.22cm of ans]  (meas) {Measure\\$\langle Z_i\rangle$};
